title: Chiseled Copper Golem
description: Copper Golem now lives in Chiseled Copper Block!
body:
Now Copper Golem lives in the Chiseled Copper Blocks!

This resource pack changes the Chiseled Copper in all of its stages to represent the Copper Golem mob as other chiseled blocks also represent mobs.
